== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34809) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Huo LS MWYHLv.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 27 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 27 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>0e92fb2c26c5ec3965acd6d08d72aa6c741c4424d5c51d9f1b70af1fa3f54c04</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.
